Cyber Attack Hits Indian Electric Utilities, KEC International Ltd Among Firms Affected

A major cyber attack has struck several firms in India’s electric utilities sector, disrupting operations and raising concerns about the safety of critical infrastructure. The incident, which began late Monday night, has been described by industry sources as a sophisticated ransomware attack targeting internal IT systems and key operational networks.

KEC International Ltd, a prominent player in the industry, confirmed on Tuesday that its IT systems have suffered outages, impacting project management and billing operations. "We are working closely with cybersecurity experts and government authorities to contain the breach and restore normalcy," said S. Ramesh, spokesperson for KEC International Ltd. "Our priority is to ensure the safety and reliability of essential services."

Other companies, including the regional utility provider Eastern Powergrid Solutions, have also reported disruptions in digital services, though the full extent of the impact remains unclear. According to the Indian Power Sector Association, at least seven utilities across five states have reported similar issues, with several unable to access customer management systems or internal communication platforms.

"Though power supplies remain largely unaffected so far, the attack has complicated routine operations, especially in customer service and maintenance scheduling," said Dr. Anita Varma, an independent energy analyst. "This incident highlights the urgent need for robust cyber defences in the sector."

Authorities from the Central Electricity Authority are currently investigating the breach, and have urged all utilities across the country to review their cybersecurity protocols. The National Power Employees Union has called for additional support and training for staff to respond to cyber threats.

As the situation develops, industry leaders warn that the attack could hinder project timelines and increase operational costs if not swiftly contained. Investigations and recovery efforts are ongoing at the time of writing.
